user.title: Set up AwoX Connect.Z
user.description: Choose whether mesh data should be imported automatically through AwoX / EGLO HomeControl or configured fully locally.

menu_option_descriptions.cloud: Automatically imports compatible lamps, mesh addresses and mesh credentials from the HomeControl account.
menu_option_descriptions.local: No cloud login. Enter the mesh name and mesh password directly, then select discovered lamps or enter MAC and mesh ID manually.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure AwoX account
reconfigure.description: Sign in again with the same AwoX/EGLO HomeControl account. The integration refreshes the current lamp list, mesh addresses and mesh credentials from the cloud. The account password and cloud session token are not stored.

bluetooth_confirm.title: New AwoX Connect.Z lamp discovered
bluetooth_confirm.description: Home Assistant discovered **{name}** with mesh address **{mesh_id}**. When adding it, the integration checks locally whether the lamp belongs to an already configured AwoX mesh. No cloud credentials are required.

cloud.title: Sign in to AwoX / EGLO HomeControl
cloud.description: Sign in once with your AwoX/EGLO HomeControl account. All compatible BLE lights in the account are imported automatically. The account password and cloud session token are not stored.

local.title: Set up a local AwoX mesh
local.description: Enter the **existing** mesh name and mesh password. The integration cannot read these credentials from the lamp and does not create or provision a new mesh. Home Assistant then automatically searches for matching Connect.Z lamps. No cloud login is used.

local_manual.title: Add a Connect.Z lamp manually
local_manual.description: Fallback for a lamp that did not send a complete long advertisement during the automatic scan. Enter its Bluetooth MAC address and individual 16-bit mesh ID. The known mesh credentials are verified locally. A successful check is remembered for this setup flow and is not repeated during final save.

reconfigure_local.title: Reconfigure local AwoX mesh
reconfigure_local.description: Update the **existing** mesh credentials. The integration cannot read them from the lamps and does not provision a new mesh. The new credentials are verified against at least one configured lamp; additional lamps can then be discovered automatically or entered manually.

local_devices.title: Select lamps for the local mesh
local_devices.description: The list contains **{count}** candidate(s). Automatically discovered devices are only included when a fresh complete long advertisement is seen during the current **{seconds}-second scan window**. Manually added devices and previously detected mesh-ID conflicts intentionally remain in the list.

data_description.manual_add: Submitting opens the manual entry form. After a successful local authentication you return to this list and can add more lamps or finish setup.
data_description.rescan: Starts another active scan in the same setup flow. Newly discovered lamps are automatically added to the selection.

reconfigure_local_devices.title: Manage devices in the local mesh
reconfigure_local_devices.description: This hub already contains **{existing_count}** lamp(s). The list contains **{count}** new or correction-needed candidate(s). Automatic hits come from the current **{seconds}-second scan window**; manual candidates and known mesh-ID conflicts may intentionally remain across rescans.

data_description.rescan: Starts another active 30-second scan in the same dialog. Newly discovered lamps are automatically added to the selection.
data_description.manual_add: Opens manual entry for the Bluetooth MAC address and mesh ID. You will return to this dialog afterwards.

cloud_review.title: Review cloud import
cloud_review.description: The account contains **{import_count}** new lamp(s) that can be imported. **{skipped_count}** lamp(s) already managed by another AwoX Connect.Z entry will be skipped. Continue to import only the new lamps.

reconfigure_cloud_review.title: Review cloud reconfiguration
reconfigure_cloud_review.description: After this update, **{import_count}** lamp(s) will remain in this cloud entry. **{skipped_count}** lamp(s) now managed by another AwoX Connect.Z entry will be skipped. Continue to apply this list.

local_devices_empty.title: Select lamps for the local mesh
local_devices_empty.description: Home Assistant actively scanned for **{seconds} seconds**. **No matching Connect.Z lamps were found.** Old Bluetooth cache entries are not treated as new discoveries. You can scan again or add a lamp manually.

data_description.rescan: Starts another active 30-second scan in the same dialog. Newly discovered lamps are automatically added to the selection.
data_description.manual_add: Opens manual entry for the Bluetooth MAC address and mesh ID. You will return to this dialog afterwards.

reconfigure_local_devices_empty.title: Manage devices in the local mesh
reconfigure_local_devices_empty.description: This hub already contains **{existing_count}** lamp(s). Home Assistant actively scanned for additional or correction-needed devices for **{seconds} seconds**. **No matching Connect.Z lamps were found.** You can scan again or add a lamp manually.

data_description.rescan: Starts another active 30-second scan in the same dialog. Newly discovered lamps are automatically added to the selection.
data_description.manual_add: Opens manual entry for the Bluetooth MAC address and mesh ID. You will return to this dialog afterwards.

error.cannot_connect: The AwoX cloud is currently unreachable.
error.no_devices: No compatible BLE lights were found in the AwoX account.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred while importing the account.
error.not_same_mesh: The lamp could not authenticate with any locally stored AwoX mesh credential. It likely belongs to a different mesh or has not yet been provisioned in the AwoX app.
error.device_unavailable: A reliable local Bluetooth connection to the lamp could not be made right now. Close the AwoX app if necessary and try again.
error.invalid_mesh_credentials: The lamp rejected the entered mesh name or mesh password.
error.invalid_mac: The Bluetooth MAC address is invalid.
error.invalid_mesh_id: The mesh ID must be between 1 and 65534. Decimal values or hex values such as 0xD361 are accepted.
error.mesh_id_mismatch: The entered mesh ID does not match the mesh ID currently advertised by this lamp.
error.cloud_devices_already_configured: All lamps from this cloud account are already configured in another AwoX Connect.Z entry. The same lamp cannot be managed simultaneously by a local mesh entry and another integration entry.
error.device_unavailable_named: The lamp **{failed_device}** could not be reached for local authentication. Check power, Bluetooth range, and whether another app is holding a connection.
error.invalid_mesh_credentials_named: The mesh credentials were rejected by {failed_device}.
error.device_already_configured_named: The lamp {failed_device} is already configured in another AwoX Connect.Z entry.
error.mesh_id_mismatch_named: The mesh ID for {failed_device} conflicts with the current advertisement: stored/manual **{entered_mesh_id}**, advertisement **{advertised_mesh_id}**. Please enter the lamp manually with the correct mesh ID.
error.devices_unavailable_named: The following selected lamps could not be reached for local authentication: **{failed_device}**. Check power, Bluetooth range, and whether another app is holding a connection to the lamp.
error.mesh_credentials_rejected_named: The mesh credentials were rejected by the following lamps: **{failed_device}**.
error.local_verification_failed_named: Multiple local checks failed. Unreachable: **{unavailable_devices}**. Mesh credentials rejected: **{rejected_devices}**.
error.mesh_credential_required: This field must not be empty.
error.mesh_credential_invalid: This value could not be encoded as UTF-8.
error.mesh_credential_too_long: A maximum of 16 UTF-8 bytes is allowed. Non-ASCII characters may use more than one byte.
error.active_scan_failed: The active Bluetooth scan could not be started or completed. Home Assistant continued collecting normal Bluetooth advertisements for the rest of the scan window. You can run the search again.

abort.already_configured: This AwoX account is already configured.
abort.wrong_account: The entered credentials belong to a different AwoX account. The existing entry was not changed.
abort.reconfigure_successful: The AwoX account data and lamp list were refreshed successfully.
abort.account_required: At least one AwoX Connect.Z cloud account or local mesh must be configured before advertisement discovery can add lamps. This device may be rediscovered by a later advertisement after setup.
abort.device_already_configured: This AwoX Connect.Z lamp is already configured in Home Assistant.
abort.incomplete_advertisement: A complete Connect.Z state advertisement with a valid mesh address has not been received yet.
abort.identity_mismatch: The identity data in the advertisement does not match the Bluetooth address.
abort.no_local_devices: No unconfigured Connect.Z lamp with a complete long advertisement is currently available. You can enter the device data manually instead.
abort.local_setup_incomplete: The local setup is incomplete. Start the setup flow again.
abort.local_devices_added: {count} lamp(s) were added to the existing local mesh.
abort.device_configured_during_setup: The lamp **{device}** was claimed by another AwoX Connect.Z entry while this setup flow was open. No duplicate entry was saved.

data_description.max_concurrent_commands: Maximum number of AwoX lamp commands that may run at the same time for this mesh entry (1-32). Higher values require enough Bluetooth connection capacity.
data_description.availability_timeout: Time without Bluetooth liveness or a working HA connection before a lamp is marked unavailable (10–300 seconds).
